observations.content: JWT-based auth with 15-minute access tokens, refresh tokens stored in httpOnly cookies
No role-based access control yet; all authenticated users have equal permissions
Users table has id, email, name, created_at, plan_tier (free|pro enum)
No billing_address, payment_method, or subscription fields exist on users
REST endpoints follow /api/v1/{resource} convention, all return JSON with { data, error, meta } envelope
No webhook handling infrastructure exists; all communication is request-response
Previous project: webhook signature verification was missed initially, leading to forged event processing in staging
Previous project: not storing Stripe customer ID on user model caused orphaned subscriptions during user deletion
Previous project: checkout endpoint without idempotency keys caused 3 duplicate charges during a deploy with retries enabled
Using Stripe Elements or Checkout keeps you in PCI SAQ-A scope; handling raw card numbers puts you in SAQ-D (full audit)
Current model: flat monthly fee, $10/mo for pro tier, free tier has usage limits
CEO mentioned exploring usage-based pricing at last all-hands but no decision made
Billing must be live before May 1 launch; 4 weeks from today
